maintainer: Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd.

paint_system_highly_corrosive_coastal.note: high-build, zinc-rich primer + epoxy + polyurethane topcoat

hot_dip_galvanizing.note: zinc coating on structural sections; thinner than paint but metallurgically bonded

protection_by_component.recommended_protection: High-build paint - zinc-rich primer + epoxy + polyurethane topcoat, near-white blast preparation
protection_by_component.reason: Large members, handled carefully, protected by cladding
High surface area, site-cut frequently, abrasion-prone during installation

protection_by_component.recommended_protection: Hot-dip galvanized or mechanical zinc plating
protection_by_component.reason: Small parts, high surface-to-volume ratio, critical fastening function
Partially inaccessible after construction; repair extremely difficult

protection_by_component.recommended_protection: Aluminium-zinc alloy coated steel, or HDG with colour coat
protection_by_component.reason: Thin gauge - paint-only on thin sheet has a limited life in highly corrosive coastal exposure

protection_by_component.recommended_protection: Heavy-build epoxy paint with inspection protocol
protection_by_component.reason: Hot-dip galvanizing not typically available in the required sections

three_coat_paint_inland_service_years.note: with annual inspection and minor spot repairs

field_checks.requirement: Near-white blast cleaning verified by visual comparison against reference photographs of correctly prepared surfaces, or by a surface profile gauge.
field_checks.failure_mode: Power-tool grinding without blasting shortens service life regardless of paint quality.

field_checks.requirement: Measured per coat and at final completion with a certified gauge; specification states min and max for each coat and for the total system.
field_checks.failure_mode: A supplier who cannot specify thickness by coat is not controlling the output.
